target.title: feat(providers): refresh Qwen, Cohere, and Mistral catalogs
target.body:
Closes #102460

## What Problem This Solves

Qwen and Cohere users cannot select several current models from OpenClaw's direct-provider catalogs, current Qwen Coding Plan models are hidden by stale endpoint filtering, and Mistral Small 4 is advertised with outdated context and pricing metadata.

## Why This Change Was Made

Refresh the provider-owned static catalogs from current official contracts: add Qwen 3.7 Max/Plus with endpoint-aware availability, add Cohere North Mini Code 1.0 with its binary reasoning mapping, and align both Mistral Small 4 IDs with current context, pricing, and reasoning behavior. Existing provider defaults, auth flows, protocols, and config surfaces stay unchanged.

## User Impact

Users can select Qwen 3.7 Plus on Coding Plan or Standard endpoints, Qwen 3.7 Max on Standard endpoints, and Cohere North Mini Code directly. Mistral users get accurate Small 4 limits/pricing plus the pinned `mistral-small-2603` model with the same default-off reasoning controls as `mistral-small-latest`.

## Evidence

- Official contracts checked:
  - Qwen Coding Plan exact allowlist: https://docs.qwencloud.com/coding-plan/overview
  - Qwen model limits and pricing: https://docs.qwencloud.com/developer-guides/getting-started/text-generation-models and https://docs.qwencloud.com/developer-guides/getting-started/pricing
  - Cohere North Mini Code and Compatibility API: https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/north-mini-code-1.0 and https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/compatibility-api
  - Mistral Small 4: https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-small-4-0-26-03
- Live direct API proof:
  - Qwen `qwen3.7-max` and `qwen3.7-plus`: HTTP 200, expected `OC-QWEN-LIVE` completion.
  - Mistral `mistral-small-latest` and `mistral-small-2603`: HTTP 200, expected `OC-MISTRAL-LIVE` completion.
  - Cohere direct inference was not run because no approved Cohere credential was available; official API contract plus emitted-payload tests cover `max_tokens` and `reasoning_effort` (`none`/`high`).
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx2rcatyw1a4wfpbkpgpr4ez`:
  - Focused Qwen/Cohere/Mistral suites: 46 tests passed across 7 files; final Qwen parity rerun: 19 tests passed across 3 files.
  - `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed`: passed, including extension production/test typechecks, extension lint, import-cycle, database-first, and repository guards.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
